section_summary.extract_value: This section presents further analyses of body appreciation data from two studies. Study 1 (n=343) examined correlations between body appreciation (measured with the 10-item BAS) and various outcomes including BMI, finding significant negative correlations in women (r=-.19) but not in men (r=-.13). Study 2 analyzed data from Swami and Ng (2015) involving 874 participants (457 women, 417 men) who completed the Cantonese version of the BAS-2, with results from a 2×2 ANCOVA showing men had significantly higher body appreciation than women after controlling for age and BMI.
